name: ThreeUI Community SectionButton adaptation
changes: Preserved SectionButton title and decorative circle structure plus layered pseudo-element styling.
Added native React button props and ref forwarding, accessible decoration and Crownfall event/data attributes.
Applied shared Ealdholt forest and brass visual values, responsive controls and visible focus states.
Replaced continuous reflection animation with a static reflection and brief hover/focus transitions.
assetScope: Only the MIT component and CSS pattern are adapted; no upstream illustrations, preview scenes or shader modules are bundled.
